_doc: Which model runs the Step 4B screenshot review (render.design-review). Versioned decision record, read by src/reviewer.ts. The Step 4B prompt asks for a reviewer from a different vendor than the builder (CLAUDE.md §6: ideally not the same model/vendor). Today's builder is Agent 37 hermes-agent. A reviewer from the builder's vendor is refused unless sameVendorAsBuilder names who approved it and when; every report and audit row marks such a review as same-vendor. Change = bump version.

decision.why: Every Agent 37 screenshot review traced so far failed: 4 of 4 calls on 2026-10-13 were cut at 300.4-300.9 s by Node's fetch header timeout (UND_ERR_HEADERS_TIMEOUT, reproduced locally at 301,008 ms), and earlier ones ended in HTTP 502 (2026-10-07) or an empty answer (2026-10-12). Three Track A builds (b880a7d5, 456368c5, 63278e56) passed every deterministic check and halted only here. Claude via the Anthropic API has working credits (the direction step ran on it 2026-10-13) and is a different vendor from the Agent 37 builder. Known limit: Agent 37 does not document its underlying model, so a shared model family cannot be ruled out; the QA evaluator is also Claude, so reviewer and evaluator share a vendor (they check different things: screenshots against the rulebook, text against the brief).

agent37.status: previous reviewer (1.0.0, same vendor as builder, approved by Huraira 2026-10-01); no review succeeded live
